children.text: Part 3 of 5 of an interview with Dr. Américo Paredes. Dr. Paredes shares his experience having different jobs, including singing on the radio, working for Pan America, writing for The Herald, and traveling to different countries before obtaining his undergraduate degree in his mid-30s. Dr. Paredes also shares the importance of popularizing Mexican culture and revisiting cultural roots.
